name: Payment Remainder
script:
today = frappe.utils.nowdate() base_url = frappe.utils.get_url() invoices = frappe.get_all("Sales Invoice", filters={ "docstatus": 1, "outstanding_amount": [">", 0], "due_date": [">=", "2025-07-14"] }, fields=["name", "customer", "due_date", "outstanding_amount", "owner"] ) reminder_schedule = { 0: "1", 2: "2", 4: "3", 7: "4", 10: "5", 12: "6", 15: "7" } signature = ( "

Ravi Products
" "Ph: 080-28600030 / 37
" "Email: accounts@raviproducts.in

" ) for inv in invoices: doc = frappe.get_doc("Sales Invoice", inv.name) days_diff = frappe.utils.date_diff(today, doc.due_date) reminder_number = reminder_schedule.get(days_diff) if not reminder_number: continue invoice = doc.name customer = doc.customer amount = doc.outstanding_amount # Manually build subject and message if reminder_number == "1": subject = "Payment Reminder – Invoice #" + invoice message = ( "

Dear " + customer + ",

" "

This is a gentle reminder that payment for Invoice " + invoice + " amounting to ₹" + str(amount) + " is due.

" "

If the payment has already been made, please share the UTR number for our reference.
" "Let us know if you have any questions.

" "

Best regards,

" + signature ) elif reminder_number == "2": subject = "Follow-Up: Payment Reminder for Invoice #" + invoice message = ( "

Dear " + customer + ",

" "

This is a follow-up regarding Invoice " + invoice + " for ₹" + str(amount) + ", which is still showing as unpaid in our records.

" "

Kindly arrange the payment at the earliest. If already paid, please share the UTR number so we can update our records accordingly.

" "

Appreciate your prompt attention to this matter.

" "

Best regards,

" + signature ) elif reminder_number == "3": subject = "Follow-Up: Pending Payment for Invoice #" + invoice message = ( "

Dear " + customer + ",

" "

REMINDER 3.

" "

This is our 3rd reminder regarding Invoice " + invoice + " for ₹" + str(amount) + ", which is still outstanding.

" "

Please arrange for the payment at the earliest. If the payment has already been processed, kindly share the UTR number for our records.

" "

Let us know if you need any further information.

" "

Best regards,

" + signature ) elif reminder_number == "4": subject = "Urgent: Payment Still Pending for Invoice #" + invoice message = ( "

Dear " + customer + ",

" "

REMINDER 4.

" "

This is a further reminder that Invoice " + invoice + " for ₹" + str(amount) + " is still pending despite our previous follow-ups.

" "

We kindly request that the payment be processed immediately. If payment has already been made, please share the UTR number to help us reconcile our records.

" "

Your prompt attention to this matter would be greatly appreciated.

" "

Best regards,

" + signature ) elif reminder_number in ["5", "6", "7"]: subject = "Immediate Attention Required: Overdue Invoice #" + invoice message = ( "

Dear " + customer + ",

" "

REMINDER " + reminder_number + ".

" "

This is to bring to your attention that Invoice " + invoice + ", amounting to ₹" + str(amount) + ", remains unpaid despite multiple reminders.

" "

We request that the payment be cleared without any further delay. If it has already been made, kindly share the UTR number to avoid any disruptions.

" "

Please consider this matter urgent. Feel free to contact us if there are any concerns or issues from your side.

" "

Best regards,

" + signature ) else: continue # Avoid duplicates already_sent = frappe.db.exists("Email Queue", { "reference_doctype": "Sales Invoice", "reference_name": invoice, "subject": subject, "status": "Sent" }) if already_sent: continue # Get customer email contact_email = None contact_links = frappe.get_all("Dynamic Link", filters={ "link_doctype": "Customer", "link_name": customer, "parenttype": "Contact" }, fields=["parent"] ) if contact_links: contact_doc = frappe.get_doc("Contact", contact_links[0].parent) if contact_doc.email_ids: contact_email = contact_doc.email_ids[0].email_id if not contact_email: continue pdf_data = frappe.get_print( doctype="Sales Invoice", name=invoice, print_format="RP - GST Invoice", as_pdf=True ) frappe.sendmail( recipients=[contact_email], subject=subject, message=message, attachments=[{ "fname": invoice + ".pdf", "fcontent": pdf_data }], reference_doctype="Sales Invoice", reference_name=invoice )
